_law: The reusable voice LIBRARY. Every entry is a named, tagged voice recipe (Breeze design, cfg 4.0). Names are PROPOSALS for Robert to keep/rename. Render + audition: node lab/engine/render_breeze.mjs library -> library/LIBRARY_LINEUP.mp3. Lock a pick by copying library/<id>.wav(+.ref.txt) to wherever it's used and recording it on the CASTING_BOARD. Seed ledger continues from cast (500+ block).

voices.name: Sonny Cash
voices.note: Robert's explicit ask: Black female early-20s gossip podcaster.
voices.design: Feminine, Black American woman in her early twenties, gossip-podcast host, bright quick higher-register voice with light vocal fry on the ends, playful and animated, general American with urban inflection, fast conversational pace that rushes when she is excited, messy-fun energy, laughs mid-sentence, close-mic bedroom-studio clarity, clear crisp
voices.ref_text: Okay, so nobody in this room wanted to say it, but I will, because that is literally my whole job. He liked the post, unliked it, THEN blocked her? Baby. We are not okay.
